crop":null,"nodeId":"4dcda782bcba446f9a64eb83f2c5568c"}}]}]},{"type":"list_item","attrs":{"level":0,"hidden":false,"dataListItemDiffId":"ct-list-item-diff-id-6633b943-afd9-4c4a-9fea-6c15ec89a161","fontSize":null,"value":null,"nodeId":"515a1b2261d74895be5fbb28599524f7"},"content":[{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"0e8817fa-b53d-4981-8fa9-de88f77dc3a7","nodeId":"d17ff77fcd6946f4a3672ff4f71125ce"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"color","attrs":{"color":"#000"}}],"text":"蛋糕店-小猪佩奇指向蛋糕样式"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"5ee1870b-50af-4cac-8762-72be22bad54d","nodeId":"01d6d38230b34a7f8add7c18b8dda3ef"},"content":[{"type":"image","attrs":{"src":"https://km.sankuai.com/api/file/cdn/1625624952/234966756705?contentType=1&isNewContent=false","small":"https://km.sankuai.com/api/file/cdn/1625624952/234961228178?contentType=1&isNewContent=false","origin":"https://km.sankuai.com/api/file/cdn/1625624952/234962025644?contentType=1&isNewContent=false","mss":"","name":"","title":null,"width":127,"height":135,"link":null,"border":false,"isFullWidth":false,"crop":null,"nodeId":"a771d99dcef74031aefb9853f50567e2"}}]}]}]}]}]}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"905267f0-0b34-4cef-bbb1-2811c504ebcc","nodeId":"ff3f348b38d14cafb0ce538e3d9cc0e7"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"管控原则："}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"096791c2-b645-4141-a334-cdfda34ceb26","nodeId":"b687e4beed0746e188a8535dacebbe15"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"strong"}],"text":"网络安全法"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"73f27b53-0b59-4afa-a272-bf1c7313ab6b","nodeId":"a23b49364cba4356810076b3710527f8"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"第十二条　国家保护公民、法人和其他组织依法使用网络的权利，促进网络接入普及，提升网络服务水平，为社会提供安全、便利的网络服务，保障网络信息依法有序自由流动。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"start","dataDiffId":"fbcfea61-9e2f-44de-a48d-4f7b2961fa1f","nodeId":"8cb50dd064e940d698a7736162e8a735"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"任何个人和组织使用网络应当遵守宪法法律，遵守公共秩序，尊重社会公德，不得危害网络安全，不得利用网络从事危害国家安全、荣誉和利益，煽动颠覆国家政权、推翻社会主义制度，煽动分裂国家、破坏国家统一，宣扬恐怖主义、极端主义，宣扬民族仇恨、民族歧视，传播暴力、淫秽色情信息，编造、传播虚假信息扰乱经济秩序和社会秩序，以及侵害他人名誉、隐私、知识产权和其他合法权益等活动。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"5bb0ade7-c094-4de0-a7b9-2d9fa8fed704","nodeId":"2772a1347ae84bba9c0dded2a33a4968"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"strong"}],"text":"网络信息内容生态治理规定"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"3dfed0fa-c843-4d5f-a1ec-0e4ca43285c1","nodeId":"a2e4fb1d51274afabf90287b51355a2c"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"　"},{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"color","attrs":{"color":"rgb(0, 0, 128)"}},{"type":"strong"}],"text":"第六条"},{"type":"text","text":"　网络信息内容生产者不得制作、复制、发布含有下列内容的违法信息："}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"start","dataDiffId":"c4baaa5e-e471-41e6-8b93-bb352f3f481a","nodeId":"a32577ed19f7401aa83a5ad1ba0a9307"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"　　(一)反对宪法所确定的基本原则的；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"start","dataDiffId":"5215f6a1-6ed9-443a-b921-76032543be4e","nodeId":"2a7e2ec159a04932a920ff0c0d4c0778"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"　　(二)危害国家安全，泄露国家秘密，颠覆国家政权，破坏国家统一的；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"start","dataDiffId":"6e6656d3-9a55-4872-97bf-fc01a81b09fa","nodeId":"d296cb2a346c4afb8b044d0702dcba23"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"　　(三)损害国家荣誉和利益的；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"start","dataDiffId":"8cba5638-1938-44ca-a094-7bdc634a5065","nodeId":"1210ae856be54a1bb1ffc94af4515da4"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"　　(四)歪曲、丑化、亵渎、否定英雄烈士事迹和精神，以侮辱、诽谤或者其他方式侵害英雄烈士的姓名、肖像、名誉、荣誉的；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"start","dataDiffId":"ef8ef627-771f-4557-8d3a-2e0406b8be36","nodeId":"9f731d464c2c4ec1a15533dcf14794d1"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"　　(五)宣扬恐怖主义、极端主义或者煽动实施恐怖活动、极端主义活动的；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"start","dataDiffId":"309ca1e5-6f73-4ecb-8724-2db81811ebb6","nodeId":"0a98d0fe5a4547b585b4562a8e5eb570"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"　　"},{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"underline"}],"text":"(六)煽动民族仇恨、民族歧视，破坏民族团结的；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"start","dataDiffId":"8f2bd1bf-a291-4984-81f3-c8ca278074eb","nodeId":"f6b9323620f744d38eccdeb53fdb13e5"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"　　"},{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"underline"}],"text":"(七)破坏国家宗教政策"},{"type":"text","text":"，宣扬邪教和封建迷信的；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"start","dataDiffId":"56133eac-1f08-4a7f-a70f-21e0dde7ba71","nodeId":"baed6121a63846ee8c005121172e65b5"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"　　(八)散布谣言，扰乱经济秩序和社会秩序的；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"start","dataDiffId":"270030c9-e29d-401c-bb33-6be4a7190a32","nodeId":"b41b4a979f3e459c91bcc0d73ca4ae6b"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"　　(九)散布淫秽、色情、赌博、暴力、凶杀、恐怖或者教唆犯罪的；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"start","dataDiffId":"27742652-b863-4e91-9fdc-e0ab0340bfb4","nodeId":"b9435bb3eddf4115b5a38172686451b2"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"　　(十)侮辱或者诽谤他人，侵害他人名誉、隐私和其他合法权益的；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"start","dataDiffId":"a7278061-6d55-4790-a0f1-da827fd0418d","nodeId":"83209cd9e0d44e538c739903992f9188"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"　　(十一)法律、行政法规禁止的其他内容。"}]},{"type":"attachment","attrs":{"src":"https://km.sankuai.com/api/file/cdn/1625624952/142622350241?contentType=0","size":"18.17MB","name":"民族宗教.pdf","align":"left","dataDiffId":"a9299136-f9e6-4674-8006-31b4681367ea","expand":false,"paste":0,"nodeId":"aefdfc40bc7140fea2cffcd5c21ab039"}},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"left","dataDiffId":null,"nodeId":"69440a2db9f44dddb4a8e6fd9d8d8e4c"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"​"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"2531e429-eb57-4b71-8473-839a86d46c16","nodeId":"b63c72a4a9894199862da40228d289c9"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"​"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"b800dc0c-2db0-48c1-b813-10c1a128721b","nodeId":"cf945c4b4a06443e968f3b3260cdc92e"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"color","attrs":{"color":"rgb(0, 128)"}},{"type":"strong"}],"text":"互联网宗教信息服务管理办法"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"15f80e54-a409-402c-b1e6-6182098a9bde","nodeId":"968584ebe74041af8212f236c48b37b3"},"content":[{"type":"link","attrs":{"id":"d77ad56d-d7ad-4ca2-ade1-c2e1ef65e10d","href":"https://www.cac.gov.cn/2021-12/20/c_1641594960049078.htm","title":"https://www.cac.gov.cn/2021-12/20/c_1641594960049078.htm","autoUpdate":false,"nodeId":"9ff72d510a3e423880894eec38e2cf1f"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"https://www.cac.gov.cn/2021-12/20/c_1641594960049078.htm"}]}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"80b954a6-3a50-4861-9470-3480704092c2","nodeId":"71f6bfa05a984111aed381cae21fc7f0"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":" 互联网宗教信息不得含有下列内容："}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"d102f18e-11f2-4a8a-891d-60ee5741027c","nodeId":"0c1fc8a772774a1b89a0309ca7e66cb8"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"（一）利用宗教煽动颠覆国家政权、反对中国共产党的领导，破坏社会主义制度、国家统一、民族团结和社会稳定，宣扬极端主义、恐怖主义、民族分裂主义和宗教狂热的；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"616a3199-edbd-400e-b20c-509f6704e45c","nodeId":"698b1e5f493745818786cac6b9ed2c5a"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"（二）利用宗教妨碍国家司法、教育、婚姻、社会管理等制度实施的；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"34c1a934-2688-47d9-b27d-db3864eb7c23","nodeId":"a61b68b6704a45c091dfb078c3173082"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"（三）利用宗教宣扬邪教和封建迷信，或者利用宗教损害公民身体健康，欺骗、胁迫取得财物的；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"de6df2ce-df80-4489-8a96-aade65e559a1","nodeId":"a34ba80362984a0390768ccb8d7a0284"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"（四）违背我国宗教独立自主自办原则的；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"55c5e6ad-6668-417e-be70-fbce50f36e66","nodeId":"c82eae57a26c4714aa9dcbb6349b1220"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"（五）破坏不同宗教之间、同一宗教内部以及信教公民与不信教公民之间和睦相处的；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"64b4e011-a3e9-4a13-b2bf-8c25b0a2fc54","nodeId":"260d5046695f4600a09fbbb2fbf764e6"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"（六）歧视、侮辱信教公民或者不信教公民，损害信教公民或者不信教公民合法权益的；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"ad9a662f-68a6-4e0b-abe6-db495d3f42e6","nodeId":"7b56d83d5c674c0a8722a94855321543"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"（七）从事违法宗教活动或者为违法宗教活动提供便利的；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"4c03e000-90f1-4bf7-af53-45a5b7c5160d","nodeId":"85953285dec34f168ba7971738a5195d"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"（八）诱导未成年人信教，或者组织、强迫未成年人参加宗教活动的；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"03a889e8-3414-41e7-8d9f-a33988a49a64","nodeId":"1fd28c856e5e4c71b194d7112f73e809"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"（九）以宗教名义进行商业宣传，经销、发送宗教用品、宗教内部资料性出版物和非法出版物的；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"b6d16401-1bf2-4c54-9f15-cbd211db3221","nodeId":"1b1811d7e50f47e3b245caa8e87a50f6"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"（十）假冒宗教教职人员开展活动的；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"b7c77812-0f61-4c91-a8d5-29f45fb0424e","nodeId":"ff8948658d1943619c58343020507ad7"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"（十一）有关法律、行政法规和国家规定禁止的其他内容的。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"46a77b43-29b0-4942-ae4e-af7cae5318b8","nodeId":"5842c2b1f7cb4283b99e2ce9b5ed81d8"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"第十五条 取得《互联网宗教信息服务许可证》的宗教团体、宗教院校和寺观教堂，可以且仅限于通过其依法自建的互联网站、应用程序、论坛等由宗教教职人员、宗教院校教师讲经讲道，阐释教义教规中有利于社会和谐、时代进步、健康文明的内容，引导信教公民爱国守法。参与讲经讲道的人员实行实名管理。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"f4ee9e0b-420e-4d37-a501-8003697d3344","nodeId":"94bec95b80ec4cadb2e3827af0e1a7cf"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"第十六条
